query: We surveyed 80 users. 28% say they would be 'very disappointed' if they could no longer use our product.
expected_behavior: Treats the 28% Sean Ellis result as a signal to investigate, not proof of absent PMF or an automatic pivot rule
Asks about respondent sample, recruitment, product experience, and meaningful segment differences
Considers retention, repeat use, organic pull, acquisition channel, and support evidence alongside the survey
Makes a proportionate recommendation and states what evidence would change it
Does not recommend indiscriminate feature expansion or freeze all growth spending based only on this score
